name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Tracking in dMRI Space (Glasser Parcellation)
summary: Generates ROIs for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking in DWI space from a subject-space Glasser (HCP-MMP) parcellation, FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei (LGN), the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.
description: Extracts the Glasser visual areas (V1, V2, V3, V4, MT and other occipital, parietal and temporal visual regions) from an input HCP-MMP volume parcellation, adds left and right LGN from the FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei segmentation, the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, and writes them as individual ROIs and a combined parcellation in DWI space. Use it to prepare ROIs for optic radiation and visual white matter tracking when a Glasser parcellation mapped to the subject is available. The FreeSurfer input must include the thalamic nuclei segmentation.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image (dwi.nii.gz with bvals/bvecs). Used as the reference grid the ROIs are resliced into and, when no mask is given, to compute a brain mask with FSL bet.

Path to the freesurfer datatype. This NEEDS to have been run through segment thalamic nuclei app, or have the thalamic nuclei generated in the original freesurfer generation, for this to work. This is used to generate the LGN ROIs.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the thalamic nuclei segmentation (mri/ThalamicNuclei.*.mgz), e.g. from the Segment thalamic nuclei App.

inputs.description: Specify this if you want to use your custom brainmask. If neither dtiinit nor brainmask is specified, this App will create brainmask from your dwi input using FSL bet.
This is the path to the parcellation/volume datatype. This NEEDS to contain the glasser parcellation mapped to the subject. This is used to generate visual rois.
inputs.requirements: Must be the Glasser (HCP-MMP) parcellation mapped to the subject.

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation combining the Glasser visual-area ROIs, with key.txt and label.json, in DWI space.
Directory of individual binary NIfTI ROIs in DWI space: Glasser visual areas, left and right LGN (thalamic nuclei 8109/8209), optic chiasm (aseg 85) and a merged FreeSurfer exclusion ROI.

FreeSurfer cortical parcellation (aparc, aparc.a2009s or aparc.DKTatlas) whose +aseg volume is converted into the target space with mri_label2vol and used to build the FreeSurfer-derived exclusion ROIs.
Intended to add the left and right LGN ROIs to the output parcellation. Note: on this branch the scripts never read include_lgn from config.json, so the setting has no effect.
Intended to add the optic chiasm ROI to the output parcellation. Note: on this branch the scripts never read include_oc from config.json, so the setting has no effect.

failure_modes.cause: No ROIs were written to rois/rois.
failure_modes.fix: Check that the FreeSurfer input contains the thalamic nuclei segmentation and the parcellation input is the Glasser parcellation.
